mobbin:2ee08fdf-b415-43f3-8a8b-6d36107b5.summary: From Ask Linear welcome, user opens an empty Inbox, then a filled Inbox (badge 7), selects an overdue item (badge drops to 6) and reviews issue detail with triage icons.
steps: Inbox list 7 unread + overdue row, detail empty
Overdue issue selected; badge 6; detail + triage icons
steal: Step 1: Dedicated empty Inbox (“No notifications”) separate from the welcome Ask screen.
Step 2: Sidebar count (7) matches unread dots; detail pane repeats “7 unread notifications.”
Step 3: Per-row checkmark vs bell-slash — Done and Snooze are distinct controls; selecting an item drops the badge 7→6.
Step 3: Overdue callout (red calendar, “3d”) elevated above generic update reminders.
mobbin:2ee08fdf-b415-43f3-8a8b-6d36107b5.fit: Dashboard action-items inbox for pending grading, checklist review, share-recording — items open Debrief/Recording/Courses; badge count is the “what needs me” signal, not a KPI chart.

mobbin:d1d517cc-d7ac-4789-aba4-fff323093.summary: Inbox shows five unread assignment/mention rows; user opens bulk “Mark all as read” / “Delete all”; after triage the detail says no unread while the list still shows snoozed and reminder rows.
steps: Bulk menu: Mark all as read / Delete all notifications
Post-triage: no unread; list keeps snoozed + reminder
steal: Step 1: Bulk Mark all as read is separate from Delete all notifications — clear vs destroy.
Step 0–1: Per-row empty circle for individual done/dismiss beside the unread purple/blue dot.
Step 2: Snooze (“Snoozed for 1d”) and reminder (“You asked to be reminded…”) remain visible after unread is cleared; detail flips to “No unread notifications” while the list is not empty.
mobbin:d1d517cc-d7ac-4789-aba4-fff323093.fit: Model for dashboard notifications: mark-read vs dismiss vs snooze feed faculty queues that hand off to Debrief/Courses; count tracks unread only, so snoozed items stay recoverable without inflating the badge.
